reason: Maker rates the M80 on-wall 4 ohm ('4-ohm audiophile speakers'); fails the 6/8 ohm rule.
brand_notes: Axiom lists seven on-wall models on https://www.axiomaudio.com/in-wall-on-wall-speakers (M2 $648, M3 $748, M5 $998, M60 $1,898, M80 $2,298 per pair; VP100/VP180 centers). Marketed as 'preserves sound of its bookshelf equivalent'; 'on-wall only'; quick-connect power bracket; no wall-voicing statement. 30-day in-home trial, 5-year warranty. No Tier A/B measurement of any on-wall Axiom found (SoundStage/NRC measured only older bookshelf M2i/M3Ti/M22Ti/M40Ti; HomeTheaterShack single-room in-room test of M3 v3 on-wall is not Tier B).
